brief: Rename the deprecated net.transport attribute to network.transport and map the old ip_tcp and ip_udp values to the current tcp and udp values.

inputs.brief: Deprecated transport attribute, which uses the ip_tcp and ip_udp value spelling.

outputs.brief: Current transport attribute, which uses the tcp and udp value spelling.

actions: If network.transport is already present, keep it and do not overwrite it.
Write tcp to network.transport when the value is ip_tcp.
Write udp to network.transport when the value is ip_udp.
Write every other value to network.transport unchanged.
Remove net.transport once the deprecated attribute is normalized.
